name: quorum-treasury
description: Native Hedera team treasury: 2-of-3 threshold key, timelocked scheduled proposals with a minority veto, a USDC spending budget the network enforces, Chainlink-guarded SaucerSwap swaps and an HCS proposal index.

envVars.description: Funded account that pays for setup (create it free at https://portal.hedera.com)
Private key of OPERATOR_ID (ECDSA or ED25519). Never commit it.
Optional: public key of your HashPack account to make it signer 1 (otherwise setup generates 3 signer keys)
Optional: Reown/WalletConnect project id to sign with HashPack in the browser

steps.label: Open the read-only demo treasury on testnet

steps.text: Every proposal, signature, veto and budget shown there links to HashScan.

sections.title: Run your own treasury on testnet

steps.label: Get a free funded testnet account
Create the 2-of-3 treasury, ops account, signer keys and HCS index
Propose a payment and sign it as signer 2
Check every proof against the mirror node
Deploy your own SwapGuard to testnet

steps.text: Read AGENTS.md before asking a coding agent to extend the template, and docs/CUSTOMIZE.md to change M-of-N or add a proposal type.
